name: stuck
description: Traces AI coding agent activity and sends it to SigNoz

stuck.otlpEndpoint.description: The OTLP HTTP endpoint URL to send telemetry data to.

stuck.cdpPort.description: CDP remote debugging port for Antigravity agent panel.

stuck.cdpEnabled.description: Enable CDP bridge for Antigravity-specific agent instrumentation. Disable on Cursor or plain VS Code.

stuck.idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity after the last captured span before triggering a postmortem report.

stuck.signozQueryEndpoint.description: SigNoz query-service API endpoint for retrieving trace data.

stuck.llmProvider.description: LLM provider for postmortem report generation. Auto-detected from API key settings if not explicitly set.

stuck.anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key for postmortem report generation.

stuck.openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key for postmortem report generation.

stuck.ollamaEndpoint.description: Ollama API endpoint for local LLM postmortem report generation.

stuck.ollamaModel.description: Ollama model name for postmortem report generation.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
